gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-fs-asap: Distinctive in its tall middle band, Baloo Bhaijaan 2 takes the lead with open, generous curves. Asap follows in a plain sans, readable and professional, its body height nearly matching its capitals.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-fs-be-vietnam-pr: Baloo Bhaijaan 2 has a tall central band of text and curves that stay open across the whole alphabet. Be Vietnam Pro is the quiet one, with a high mean line and sans-serif strokes.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-fs-epilogue: Epilogue brings curvy, approachable sans-serif letters with a tall-bodied lowercase and a wire-like skeleton. And Baloo Bhaijaan 2 counters with a commanding display voice that carries the bigger moments.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans reads clean and professional, with a larger-than-usual x-height and no stroke modulation at all. Baloo Bhaijaan 2 sits above it as the display voice, its tall central band giving the sans-serif text below a strong lead-in.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-fs-merriweather-: Commanding and distinctive up top, Baloo Bhaijaan 2 hands off to a quieter partner underneath. Merriweather Sans keeps words looking sturdy, its tall lowercase and open e making a sans text that moves along steadily.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-fs-public-sans: Baloo Bhaijaan 2 stands out for its tall central band and open curves that run through every letter. Public Sans, a sans-serif with hefty lowercase, can sit a bit smaller.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-fs-ranade: Baloo Bhaijaan 2 is built around a tall central band of text, with open curves throughout the alphabet. Ranade follows in a sans with slight stroke shifts and widely spaced letters.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-fs-supreme: Big, bold, and wide open: Baloo Bhaijaan 2 makes a distinctive first impression with its tall central band. But Supreme, a crisp sans with a heavy-looking strip of text, keeps letters held open for a steady, unhurried read.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-general-sans: Baloo Bhaijaan 2 has a tall central band and open curves. Its job is to command attention with a distinctive display voice, while General Sans handles the steady, marker-like line of text with an x-height that fills the line.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-montserrat: Baloo Bhaijaan 2 is distinctive and commanding, with a tall central band of text and open curves throughout the alphabet. Montserrat, a geometric sans-serif, keeps a flat single-weight line.
